panels.title: Raft leader per manager
panels.description: One lane per manager: green is the Raft leader, blue a follower. Exactly one lane should be green at any time; flapping lanes mean repeated elections.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_raft_is_leader" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["node"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "leader" + r.node}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Quorum has leader
panels.description: Minimum of raft_has_leader over the selected managers: YES while every manager sees a leader, NO as soon as one does not (election in progress or no quorum).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_raft_has_leader" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: min, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "has leader"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Leader changes (range)
panels.description: Leader changes seen over the selected time range (largest count among the selected managers). 0 is normal; a few mean restarts or elections, many mean an unstable cluster.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_raft_leader_changes" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> spread()
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> max()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "leader changes"}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Raft log fsync p99

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "log write p99"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
